state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 5 (the fixes).** Stage 4's review is whole (`docs/perf/performance-review.md`, ending in `## floor`). Old refusals have not been priced again yet.

**`bun nv scaling --check` was green two sessions ago**, and nothing since has changed a ladder it already ran. Two ladders are new: `benches/scaling/strings/at.nvs` and `strings/find-next.nvs`, both flat. The tool's counts cannot see work inside a `Core` member and its ramp stopped at 8000, so the fix was proven by clock: a probe over 200,000 characters (`at`, `slice` and find-next `indexOf`) ran 1486 ms before and 41 ms after, with the same output.

**`Core\Uri::queryParameter` is a stated bound**, not a memo: the `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs` module doc *What it spends* says why, and the card sends a program reading many names to `parseQuery`. **String positions on one-byte text are O(1)** through the `_of` methods in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/granularity.rs`, whose module doc *What an index costs* states the bound for wider text.

**22 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red (`bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them), and they are the rest of Stage 5. *Decisions for you* in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` has two entries: a total deadline for the request head, and `Markup` concatenation in place.

items.text: **A `Core\Log` call below `[log] level` returns before it builds a record** (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/log.rs:231`), per `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/a-filtered-log-call-builds-its-record.json`. Check the level before the fields, the key hash, the clock and the `floor::LOG_WINDOWS` slot (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/floor.rs:558`); today `write_log_record` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/output.rs:368`) drops it last. Filtered records can push real ones out of the 16 slots, so this is a correctness fix too. Ladder `traffic/debug-log.nvs`, `serve` kind. Rule: the goal's base rule.

**The event-stream reader remembers where its last scan stopped** (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http/stream.rs:612`), per `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/an-event-stream-reparses-its-buffer-per-read.json` — a different file set, so take it only with room to spare. Rule: the goal's base rule.

backlog: 20 more gap records owned by `performance-pass`; `bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them (`docs/agent/goals/performance-pass.md` Stage 5).
`bun nv scaling` ramps `strings/at` only to 8000 and sees no clock there, so a member-internal regression in it shows only by a direct clock probe (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts`).
Old refusals priced again, per the goal's Stage 5 (`docs/agent/goals/performance-pass.md`).
